description: List a profile's posts, newest first, with where each one stands and when it goes or went out. `status` is draft, ready (approved), scheduled, publishing, published or failed. Pass `status` to keep only some: `["scheduled"]` is what is booked to go out. `q` searches the title, the caption and the idea. Pages of `limit` posts from `offset`; `total` counts every match. Discarded posts are left out. Read one in full with get_post. It only reads.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

q.description: Words from the post's title, caption or idea

status.description: Keep only posts in these states. Default: every state

name: list_posts
title: List posts
